title: When the real war begins, lukewarm hearts don’t just fade —
paragraphs:
When the real war begins, lukewarm hearts don’t just fade —
they collapse.
Only those who burn with uncompromising faith can stand when darkness rises.
🔥⚔️
This is not a season for half-hearted belief.
This is a call to spiritual warfare, a call to holy fire,
a call to wake up the warriors inside us.

Revelation 3:16 (KJV)
“So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.”
